description: Preview commissioning repeated upkeep at a real place: for each need, whether the board has governed work for it and what authority it needs (a permit or licence is never waived), the dated cycles, the measurement the Vealth Standard itself asks for, and how much NET the cycles would need in all; a preview reads no wallet and shows no balance, and your wallet is checked against that NET only when you sign. Site authority you declare, public ground included, stays unverified until a wallet the operator lists as a site-authority verifier has put its evidence on file (none is listed by default, so until the operator names one nobody can and no job links to any place); NET figures are house references, not an executable price; nothing is recorded, posted, signed, reserved or paid. Free, keyless, moves no money. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

commission.description: commissionId, principal (your wallet address, never a key), place {name,lat,lng}, siteAuthority {kind: owner|manager|association|public_ground, evidenceRef}, needs[{id,objective,everyCycles,conditionId?}], cycles (1-12), cycleDays (7-365), startAt (ISO).
